name: El Alamein: The Long Retreat
notes: Same set-up as The Last Chance; only length, reinforcements and victory differ.
End printed as the 'December 3/IV, 1942' Game-Turn; Game-Turn number not computed here (needs the turn calendar); end left at 111/3 provisionally from the garbled 63.2 text. Needs a ruling.

Axis only scores. 10+ strategic, 4-9 'substantive', 1-3 marginal, 0 Commonwealth win. Occupying needs every combat unit there to have a Game-Turn of stores, ammo to fire every weapon twice and fuel to move 20 CP.

reinforcements: Reinforcements per the schedule. Replacement points are cut to 10% of the listed maximum, rounded up (infantry and truck production unaffected); none arrive before Game-Turn 105 OpStage 1; those for 105 and 106 may be planned before the start (63.38).

Reinforcements as normal. Replacement points cut to 5% (rounded down) of the pool, all sent to Tripoli and held there; if the Axis still holds Tobruk, Bardia or Mersa Matruh at Game-Turn 105 OpStage 3, 25% may be released the next OpStage, and 25% of all available (by type, rounded up) at Game-Turn 108 OpStage 1 (63.47).
special: Strategic air attacks on Malta are allowed (63.46).
